qr_desc: Scan the QR code with your phone's camera. A page will open where you can enter your playlist details.
web_desc: Enter your playlist details here. They will be sent directly to your TV.
web_m3u_url: M3U URL or Paste M3U Text
web_success_desc: You can now close this window.
search_hint: Search for channels, movies, or series…
speech_unavailable: Speech recognition is not available on this device.
speech_language_missing: Speech recognition for the selected language is not available on this device.
continue_empty: No playback progress has been saved yet.
continue_unavailable: This content is not available in the currently loaded playlist.
download_failed: Download failed. Please check your internet connection and available storage space.
download_season_failed: Some episodes could not be downloaded. Please check your internet connection and available storage space.
stream_load_failed: The stream could not be started. Please check your playlist, internet connection, and stream URL.
playlist_management_subtitle: Name playlists, assign folders, and manage visibility
playlist_visibility_hint: Choose which playlists appear in the normal source and folder navigation. Hidden playlists remain saved and can be reactivated here at any time. Hiding a playlist does not delete any data.
playlist_empty: No playlist profiles have been saved yet. Add a playlist to manage it here.
playlist_security_note: Playlist names, folders, and visibility settings are stored in SharedPreferences. Remote M3U URLs and Xtream credentials are protected separately in Android Secure Storage. Imported local M3U files are stored in the app's private storage and can be loaded again.
